description: Local, read-only structural code navigation for Codex

defaultPrompt: Find this symbol and show its exact source range.
Show callers and references for this function.
Estimate this change's impact and likely tests.
interface.longDescription: Atlas Scout gives Codex local structural-index evidence for definitions, exact source ranges, references, static call paths, architecture, and bounded edit impact. Source code stays on the workstation; the separately installed runtime creates a disposable SQLite index in the selected workspace.

name: atlas-scout
